sloka: न शेकुरभिसंरोद्धुं राज्ञः प्रयचिकीर्ष्वः ।स सवीपस्थितो राज्ञ्स्तामवस्थामजज्ञीवान् ॥२-१४-४५॥
transliteration: na śekurabhisaṁroddhuṁ rājñaḥ prayacikīrṣvaḥ ।sa savīpasthito rājñstāmavasthāmajajñīvān ॥2-14-45॥

translations.english: Sumantra approached the king unaware of the state of his mind and commenced praising him in highly pleasing words (as usual).
